---
title: "Creative Endeavors"
format: html
---

I've always enjoyed creating art. Engaging in creative hobbies brings a lot of meaning to my life, and I'm always looking for new mediums and techniques to explore.

During my undergraduate career, I found ways to bring this into my campus life, working with the graphics desk at The Appalachian, the university's student newspaper, and running a small art business for a few years, vending at local art markets and regularly selling at the King Street Farmers Market.

**→** <a href="https://theappalachianonline.com/staff_name/emma-getz/" style="color: #9e1c57; text-decoration: none;" target="_blank">My Appalachian Portfolio</a><br> **→** <a href="https://www.instagram.com/emmalinalino/" style="color: #9e1c57; text-decoration: none;" target="_blank">My Small Business Instagram</a>

## Printmaking

I got into relief printmaking, carving designs into rubber or linoleum and printing them with ink onto paper or fabric. It's a medium that leaves a lot of room for experimentation, and I especially enjoy making greeting cards, posters, and small prints.

## Fiber Arts

More recently, I've become interested in fiber arts, particularly sewing and needlepoint. I typically sew functional pieces like bags, and occasionally clothing, while my needlepoint work often draws inspiration from scenes I've come across in nature.
